Specification: This module specifies a tiny state machine with two variables, x and S. The initial state sets x to 0 and S to the set {1,2}, and the next-state relation requires x = 0 and chooses some n from S such that the sequential action composition A(n) \cdot B(n) occurs. The specification defines the overall behavior as Init together with the temporal formula [][Next]_<<S, x>>, and it does not include fairness conditions, fault modeling, or proofs.
